sources.note: Nothing. No phonology/prosody chapter; TOC covers sociolinguistics, fieldwork, translanguaging, numerals, noun-verb distinction, variation, gesture-to-sign conventionalisation. Only hits for 'stress/accent/prosody' are incidental (Kusters 'stresses the need'; Meir & Sandler's 'accent' metaphor; mouth gestures becoming 'part of the prosody/intonation of a sign language' in a general grammaticalisation discussion).
